title: Target Block Splitting Lemma
body_html:
Target Block Splitting Lemma

For the vector \(w\) chosen in the converse proof, the image of the top source block is a nondegenerate target subspace \(bV'\), the target decomposes orthogonally as \[ V'=bV'\oplus aV', \] and \(w\) is block diagonal. The target lattice function also decomposes: \[ L'=bL'\oplus aL', \] with \(bL'_t=bw(bL_{t+s})\) and \(aL'\) self-dual.
proof_html:
Extraction

Invertibility of the top moment value on \(bV\) makes \(bw:bV\to bV'\) injective and then an isomorphism. Nondegeneracy follows by pairing through \(w^\ast w\). Orthogonality forces \(w(aV)\subseteq aV'\). The lattice splitting is proved by inclusion \(bw(bL_{t+s})\subseteq L'_t\), dualizing, and then decomposing a vector into its \(b\)- and \(a\)-components.
